turns.player_facing_text: You are at Cinderwatch Gate District. Rain, choke traffic, a notice board, and gate watch pressure frame the missing patrol inquiry. Threadbare watchers and refugees cluster along the muddy gate line. Ash Compact census delays have tightened the eastern caravan choke point. A tavern runner shouts offers of hot stew and paid rumor. You can read the notice board, press the guards, or approach the tavern runner.
